Subject: Wavefront POC — performance recap + quick endorsement request

Hi Emma / Raj —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. I pulled together a short results summary attached (wavefront_poc_results_slide.pdf) — highlights below: 

- Inference latency (tail P95) down from ~420ms to ~190ms on your median query mix when routed to the dedicated pool (≈55% reduction).
- Token cost per 1k tokens decreased by ~48% after we enabled prefix KV caching and switched to 4-bit quantized variant for non-critical routes.
- End-to-end throughput for batched order-confirmation flows improved 2.1x during your peak minutes.
- Regression: a small quality dip (0.6% hit on product classification accuracy) on long-tail SKU descriptions — we captured examples in slide 4.

The internal team (Vivek for ops + Lauren for product) are cc'd — we can annotate the slides with any additional metrics you'd like to show customers.

Two quick asks:
1) Would you be comfortable providing a 1–2 sentence customer blurb we can use in a case study / website (one-liner about the throughput or cost impact)?
2) If yes, would someone be open to a 10–15 minute reference call so we can capture a brief quote on camera? Calendar link: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/15min

If it helps, we can also share a suggested one-liner that you can edit.

Thank you — we really appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks for looping me in. Quick ops note for the thread (for the call and the one-pager):

- KV caching: we scoped prefix caching to the templated confirmation flows only (orders, refunds) to avoid polluting the cache for free-text support queries. That was the main driver of the cost reduction.
- Canary rollout: recommend a 2-week canary at 10% traffic with monitoring on product-classification accuracy for SKUs. If accuracy regresses >1% on canary, auto-fallback to the non-quantized variant.
- Materials: I'll share two short logs and the canary dashboard link during the call.

Happy to help on the call next Tue.

Vivek
